d: Sal 2014 ke lokasbha chunav men jab narendr modi ke nam ki lahar thi, tab varansi ke diem pranjal yadav ne suraksha karnon se beniyabag men unki raili ki parmishan dene se inkar kar diya tha. is phaisle ke bad bhari rajnitik ghamasan macha, lekin chunav aayog ne bhi unke phaisle ko sahi thahraya. dilchasp bat yah hai ki kangres ne un par modi ko 'speshal tritment' dene ka aarop lagaya, to vahin bijepi ne sapa samarthak hone ka. lal batti ke is episod men janie kaun hain 2006 baich ke dabang IAS pranjal yadav, unke sakht prashasnik phaisle, aur kyon vah donon dhruvon ki rajniti ke kendr men…
